text:
emily: Heads-up — customer Novarex (enterprise) says procurement will not accept any invoice unless it includes an Approved Purchase Authorization Number (APAN) and their vendor tax substantiation. They attached a proc-auth PDF and wrote: 'we cannot process invoices without APAN and company VAT doc'. Can finance add APAN to the official invoice metadata or issue a manual invoice? Also can we send a pro-forma in the meantime?

raj: @emily do we have the procurement contact? any sample APAN format they gave? if this is enterprise tier we should be flexible.

emily: Contact is sara.proc@novarex.com — procurement replied with this example: APAN: PA-2026-0098. They also attached a company VAT certificate (GB123456789).

linda: We can add a "purchase_reference" field to invoice metadata but our automated billing exports (for recognition + SAP) only pick up recognized fields. Two options: 1) I do a manual invoice (takes ~2 business days) and embed APAN + VAT in the line items/metadata; or 2) we emit a pro-forma PDF to the customer now and hold the official invoice in Draft until docs are validated. Either way we'll need the signed SOW or order confirmation + the VAT doc and the APAN string. Also need Novarex's billing address and VAT reg number on file.

billing-bot: Invoice draft created: INV-DRAFT-2026-00482 (status: draft). Assigned to @linda.

simon: Short workaround that avoids a new codepath: generate pro-forma PDF containing their APAN and VAT, send it to procurement as 'pro-forma for authorization only', then mark the real invoice as pending with a note. Linda — if you can attach the APAN into the invoice metadata I can update the billing export mapping so downstream ERP gets the field. Example metadata we can embed:
```json
{"purchase_reference": "PA-2026-0098", "tax_id": "GB123456789", "procurement_contact": "sara.proc@novarex.com"}
```
This won't break automated posting if we keep it in the purchase_reference key.

julie: Legal note — confirm contract / SOW allows invoicing after PO-like authorization. If we push a pro-forma make clear it's non-binding.

linda: Agreed on process. Emily please upload the PDF docs into the billing ticket and confirm the SOW. I'll convert INV-DRAFT-2026-00482 into a manual invoice once I have: APAN, signed SOW, VAT cert, billing address. Will escalate to revenue ops if this impacts month-end close.

emily: Uploaded: link to files (internal) — proc-auth.pdf, vat_cert.pdf, signed-sow.pdf. Sending to procurement contact now with pro-forma attached. @linda please proceed when you have the docs. I'll follow up with Novarex and update the thread. :thumbsup:

raj: Thanks team — nice clean plan. Keep me posted if they push for net30 vs our standard net15.

linda: Noted on payment terms. I'll flag if we need to change AR terms.

emily: Will do. Closing loop once finance confirms invoice issuance.
